description: Perry-only release acceptance journeys. Derived from the retired M11 comparison fixture; participant, condition, and superiority framing removed. Each journey is a live acceptance drill Perry must pass before public beta.

journeys.title: Complete onboarding and a verified Finder rename
journeys.goal: Set up Perry, then rename the supplied Finder sample from Perry benchmark draft.txt to Perry benchmark ready.txt.
journeys.setup: Use a fresh macOS test profile with equivalent starting permissions and runtime credentials. Create the harmless sample in an isolated acceptance folder. Do not pre-complete onboarding or substitute a debug demo.

assertions.description: Onboarding completes and the selected runtime can be invoked without restarting setup.
Finder and an independent filesystem inspection show the requested new filename with unchanged sample contents and no changes outside the sample.
Perry reports success only after checking the rename result.
Denied permissions, retries, and elapsed time are recorded, and the sample is restored only after timing stops and evidence is preserved.

journeys.start_event: When Perry's first launch begins for the fresh profile.
journeys.stop_event: After independent filesystem inspection confirms the renamed file and unchanged contents, before fixture restoration.

journeys.title: Follow a two-step click-advanced live guide
journeys.goal: Guide me through opening the acceptance folder in Finder and then opening the supplied text document. Let me perform both clicks.
journeys.setup: Prepare a Finder window, folder, and text document in known geometry. Request a live guide rather than delegated execution. Include one prescribed click outside the highlighted target before the first correct click.

assertions.description: The first highlight identifies the actual folder in the target Finder window.
The prescribed mismatch click does not advance the guide.
The correct first click advances only after the folder opens, and the second highlight identifies the document in the changed window.
The user opens the document and Perry verifies the second step without performing either click for them.

journeys.stop_event: After the user opens the document and the second guide step is verified.

journeys.title: Read and follow a full spatial guide
journeys.goal: Show the full guide for using Finder's view controls to switch this acceptance folder to list view and sort it by name.
journeys.setup: Use a Finder window containing seeded files, initially in icon view. Request Perry's full-guide surface. The user must use the rendered guide rather than an operator-provided walkthrough.

assertions.description: The full guide displays numbered targets and an unambiguous sequence for the requested actions, rather than unlabelled marker dots.
The spatial marks identify the correct controls in the actual Finder window without obscuring the controls needed for the task.
The user reaches list view sorted by name, confirmed by inspecting Finder's actual view and sort state.
Closing the guide removes its overlays without changing the completed Finder state.

journeys.stop_event: After the user closes the guide and an independent Finder inspection confirms list view and name sort.

journeys.title: Invoke two tasks with different spoken languages
journeys.goal: Using the supplied utterance pair, ask Perry to open the acceptance folder, then ask it to open the sample document in a different language.
journeys.setup: Before collecting observations, freeze a versioned utterance pair from the tested language compatibility matrix. Use English plus a tested non-English language with a fixed microphone/output route and network profile; do not silently replace an unsupported language with English. Preserve consented reference transcripts locally.

assertions.description: The English utterance is understood without manually changing the configured language.
The tested non-English utterance is understood without manually changing the configured language.
Each utterance dispatches exactly one requested task, and the requested folder and document open in order.
Perry provides an intelligible spoken response for each invocation without executing transcript fragments or duplicate commands.
Recognition corrections, routing failures, and fallback use are recorded, and unsupported language behavior remains a failed observation rather than a skipped one.

journeys.start_event: When the first language-specific invocation begins.
journeys.stop_event: After the second requested result is verified and its spoken response is complete.

journeys.title: Confirm and verify a foreground task
journeys.goal: Move the two named acceptance files into the supplied destination folder, asking for my approval before changing either file.
journeys.setup: Seed source files and an empty destination inside a dedicated acceptance workspace. Use no personal files. The user waits for the approval surface, inspects the scope, then approves once; retain a filesystem baseline for independent result checks.

assertions.description: No file changes occur before the user grants approval for the displayed source files and destination.
One approval continues the suspended task without repeating the plan or requesting an unrelated grant.
Both files reach the requested destination with unchanged contents, and no file outside the approved set changes.
Perry verifies the final filesystem state and reports the result accurately, with a corresponding history entry.

journeys.start_event: When the foreground task invocation begins.
journeys.stop_event: After an independent filesystem check confirms both files in the approved destination with unchanged contents and the history entry records verification.

journeys.title: Recover two independent background tasks after relaunch
journeys.goal: Run the two supplied file tasks in the background, pause the first one, and keep the second task running. After relaunch, resume the paused task.
journeys.setup: Use two disjoint seeded workspace folders with versioned multi-step tasks. Each task copies its named sample to a new destination, then waits for approval before renaming that copy. Start both tasks before either finishes. Pause task A before its write, allow task B to reach its pending approval, then quit and relaunch Perry. Preserve actual receipts and filesystem state; do not emulate relaunch by replacing a view model.

assertions.description: Both tasks have distinct identities and observable overlapping lifetimes, and pausing task A does not pause or alter task B.
After relaunch, task A remains paused and task B retains its exact pending approval and progress.
Resuming A and approving B continue the correct actions without replaying already completed copies or applying one task's approval to the other.
Both final files match their requested names and contents, no unauthorized files change, and each task has an accurate independent result and history entry.
If an action's outcome is uncertain on recovery, Perry pauses for inspection rather than replaying it, and operator recovery time is recorded.

journeys.start_event: When the first background task invocation begins.
journeys.stop_event: After both tasks' final filesystem states and independent history results are verified following relaunch and recovery.
